chunks: And with this chain, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:

I asked Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the fasting of Sha'ban: 'Did any of your ancestors fast in it?' He said: 'The best of my ancestors is the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and most of his fasting was in Sha'ban.'

key_terms.صَوْمِ شَعْبَانَ: Fasting in the month of Sha'ban

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad do regarding fasting in the month of Sha'ban?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) as the best of his forefathers in his frequent fasting during Sha'ban, a practice rooted in the belief that this month precedes Ramadan and serves as a spiritual preparation. This narration from *Thawab al-A'mal* underscores the continuity of prophetic tradition within the Ahl al-Bayt, highlighting Sha'ban not merely as a pre-Ramadan interval but as a distinct period for voluntary devotion and self-purification.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 11. And from the previous chain from al-Hussain b. Sa’eed from Abdulrahman b. Abi Najran from Yunis b. Ya’qub who said:

The narrator asked Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) about the month of Shaban, “Did any of your ancestors observe fast in these days?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “My greatest ancestor the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.s.) used to observe many fasts during Shaban.”
